summary: Routine counts describe the root-wide sampled background, not eleven independent batch totals. Broad I.1 is frequent (978 Infectum, 800 Preterit); these reader-assigned counts do not validate every sense analysis.

Agent l-suffix, patient suffix, and recipient suffix must be separated. Hors 3/12 səm-le-le has a self-beneficiary; JTM 1.1/83 brine preparation permits a cheese beneficiary. Result NPs in transformation are not interchangeable with the produced-object NP of simple manufacture.

Infectum-wa commonly presents habitual craft and recipe procedures. A Preterit can occur inside a retrospective relative clause (JL 17.5/15), without a suffixed -wa; context alone should not change its box. ko-Preterit at Hors 2/132 documents the constructed bathhouse as a present result.

Finite Detransitive preparation/manufacture suppresses the human preparer; material is often m-marked. Nonhuman plural patients can accompany singular predicates (JTM 2.1/4). Detransitive Infinitiv is the inherited nominal filing and is not evidence that every action noun has Detransitive semantics.

Light-verb nouns carry complaint, livelihood, trust, conflict and benefactive meanings. Parallel Kurdish and Turoyo expressions at JTM 3.1/28 support contact comparison, but do not establish borrowing direction for each phrase.

I.4 already includes general culinary preparation rather than only boiling. Food preparation and explicit material-to-result transformation overlap in recipes; a result predicate such as žaži/šərtan motivates I.3, while preparing a named dish motivates I.4.

Batch 2 preserves batch 1's I.16 arrangement and Detransitive 4. New 3b and 4b distinguish fractional result complements from ingredients used as inputs, respectively. Neither English 'measure' nor 'mix' is imported as a lexical gloss where the Turoyo has sym.
Paired saymatwo / saymət b-diḏi at JTM 4.5/15 contrasts a -wa condition with its unmarked counterpart in the same government construction; the inherited b-diḏ- sense remains 10.

əġfal alternates an affected suffix with an overt human patient. čara alternates benefactive requests with l-indexed adversaries, extending its existing m- elimination frame. A suffix cannot be assigned a benefactive role independently of the noun and discourse.

The copied reader claim that LuF 2/13 is an existing sym Detransitive Part. Pass. example does not match the supplied base entry, which has only the gold example; its attested fire context is added without inventing a correction ID.

Office assignment, laundry, harmful inanimate agents, and sound production remain distinct constructional observations. Laundry is indexed as a collocation; sound imitation continues the broad make/do extension.

Batch 3 adds I.17 reciprocal agreement and I.18 reflexive self-adornment. It retains earlier numbering including 3b/4b and the absent 11. Repeated proposals for festivals, smuggling, hope and self-adornment are grouped across texts and tokens.
masimat at MAC NE Famine/15 supplies Stem III Infectum, with causee b- and explicit work object. Stem III is already established; the form adds a box, not a new stem.
Caregiving alternates more/bmore and fronted or suffixed patients. New Preterit and Imperativ examples support I.2 without treating the noun as a new care sense.
Age measures recur with active Preterit, continuing the inherited 120-year example. The feminine start sǝmla ... masculine səmle is a repair, not an independent attestation of a new construction.

kār prepares both human groups and oneself. Repeated preparation contexts resolve existing I.14/I.15 misfilings. ban diḏ- compliance and ʕal iḏ- authority need separate syntactic checking before additional numbered government senses are posited.

Relational heviye hope differs from petition but belongs in the idiom's meaning variants. No missing numbered sense 11 is silently restored. idara likewise has administration, livelihood, and coping readings with different contexts.
At MAC NE Mar Dumet/28 the affirmative Turoyo office construction contrasts with an English translation adding 'no longer'; withhold an unqualified quotation and ask about rhetorical force.
Trade is expressed by taǧara, paired bēʕ w bazar, bare bazar and aləšweriš. Light sym remains stable while the nominal choice varies across texts.
ʕaskar recurs in mustering contexts including a child’s troop; a military collocation captures the evidence without assigning all army objects to acquisition I.14.

Preterit l-agent must be distinguished from recipient: lu sabʕo in PrS1/17 and lu šulṭono in PrS35/22 name actors. Extra l-suffixes in səmlele/səmlili may be self-benefactive, not extra core patients.
Sexual sym with ʕam occurs across Preterit, Infectum, Infectum-wa and Imperativ; partner can be supplied by discourse. Social ḥanak remains a distinct noun collocation.
PrS29/28 supplies an honor clause absent from its German verse translation. Reader’s German context is from verse29; no quotation added.

New occupational sayomo/sayome tokens name slipper, lock and tail makers; they support the glossary’s existing Part act. filing but do not decide whether the old tire occupation means dealer, maker or repairer.

Nominal syomo/syamto examples in Detransitive Infinitiv are unnumbered in the parsed base, not four securely labelled D1 examples. Their active care, marriage and food meanings cannot be assigned by merely copying active sense numbers into separate Detransitive numbering. Preserve the filing and pose the section question.

PrS57 distinguishes shadow theatre qaragoz, general spectacle fərǧe, təštəʕniyo performance and tricks ləʕboyat; broad sym also stands anaphorically without these nouns. No special performance verb sense is required.
šariʕa appears with judge and disputant subjects; ʕam marks the opposing party. In b-šariʕa, the judgement instead supplies what is followed, continuing I.10.

The therapeutic fox story repeatedly juxtaposes dmx and sym ʕam, then wife-partner sym. This may be euphemistic sex throughout or a deliberate sleeping ambiguity; do not publish a separate literal co-sleeping sense from the German schlafen alone.
Two supplied German clauses omit their targets: PrS48/30 army description continues in verse31; PrS58/90 lacks the introductory sym tambih clause. No examples are taken from those mismatched spans.

The retrospective confession at PrS77/50 places sym ʕam among sins, strengthening the sexual reading of the earlier fox/minister story. Keep I.8 as the provisional common anchor; this overturns no accepted sleeping sense because none was introduced.

Detransitive simo/simi contrast with feminine Part. Pass. səmto and plural sime, favoring finite Preterit analysis in material statements; mark the remaining dialect/form uncertainty. simi wo adds provisional Preterit-wa, with result predicates spacious/large filed under Detransitive I.4 rather than building I.3.

haqqayəṣ quantifies a contextual act; it is not a noun supporting a new pressure idiom. Direct-person -ux in samnux at39/17 may instead be benefactive; no new valency sense is introduced on this evidence.

Light-verb nominal families span weather, bodily sounds, social valuation, correspondence, religious observance and aggression. The noun supplies the event meaning; repeated noun families retain previous collocation decisions.

Preterit-wa səmwole aṣale is a counterfactual result after a sequence of obligations. Infectum-wa medical intention and prospectively continued correspondence likewise distinguish aspect/temporal framing without new lexical meanings.
Several reader thin-cell claims are stale against the cumulative entry: Imperativ1 and Infectum12 are already full; duplicated existing taxmin, telegram, care and feigning examples are not added.

Most recurring war, wedding, longing, worry, charity-adjacent kindness, care and petition proposals repeat earlier cumulative decisions. Variant spellings such as ḥəzbe/ḥəsbe, taʕdaye/taʕadda and tamana/tamanna are cross-linked without duplicate idioms.

The new šarṭ(at) fulfillment use differs from wagering šarṭ ʕal-: condition/task as object, not a contested proposition with stakes. Give it a distinct collocation meaning, not a new numbered lexical verb.
Physical nests remain under the inherited I.1 manufacture filing; building I.12 overlaps. The proposed claim that active3 and Detransitive3 must align is rejected: their numbering is separate.
The 65/530 soup-for-the-sick image is quoted literally, with its evaluation unresolved. Do not gloss it as seductive self-adornment merely from contextual interpretation.
ō/ə variants and contracted som/ksom forms recur in the same light-verb frames. No source spelling is normalized and no new stem is inferred from contraction.
Namardiye occurs negated with prompt action and narrative moral coloring; repeated German nicht faul does not justify a new cowardice sense. The earlier negated hesitation idiom is retained.

Marriage I.5 is now exemplified with overt spouse objects in Preterit and counterfactual Infectum-wa. The nominal syamto at69/96 is unnumbered in the base; active5 must not be copied into Detransitive numbering.
Thought nouns contrast xayalat imaginings/suspicions, ḥəzba reckoning/plans, ḥəzər time reckoning, and heviye expectation/petition. The specific noun, not plain sym, supplies the mental content.

Household bayto at77/28–32 is sustained establishment/maintenance of a household, not evidence that every bayto object means physical construction. The accompanying77/32 German omits the answer clause; do not quote it.

Repeated Preterit səmlelalle with food/coffee at73/79,112 is retained verbatim as expanded suffix packaging. The medical eyes context remains provisional I.13, distinct from feeding riders and readying horses already corrected to I.2.

Sound expressions, movement Infinitiv pairs, institutional election nouns and social/religious actions continue the light-verb pattern. Prior fətne/fəṭna discord, nawba/noba watch and suwal/suʔal question variants are cross-linked without duplicate heads.

DInfinitiv syomo continues as a morphologically filed nominal with active event readings: mortar/carpet making and breakfast preparation. Finite Detransitive misomo warzo instead has an overt result predicate and belongs to new Detransitive4, not generic1 or built3.
The negative effect construction extends beyond b-target to ʕam-target in unsuccessful medical treatment. Distinguish this outcome use from bare affective/helping nouns earlier misfiled under15.
At91/22 the German reverses participants in the first negative clause. A new example uses only the aligned second clause. Alignment-flagged88/74,88/207 and95/208 translations are not quoted.

The agricultural sequence separates ploughing/work, food preparation, container measures and technical qatakiri grain cleaning. Repeated qatakiri with wheat and lentils supports a technical collocation, not a numbered sense of sym.
Sound nouns ḥe bleating and ḥəmgeliyo sustained humming depend on the overt sound complement; he assent has a different initial consonant and meaning.
qawetiyat commissions can be conveyed messages or practical instructions. Household bayto, idara maintenance, kar w bar affairs and generic domestic do remain distinguishable noun frames.
No technical medicine sense is inferred merely from a medical noun: ḥəkmatiye treatment goes to Idiomatic phrases. Stem III masəmle continues caused manufacture with smiths as contextual causee.
Job10 reviews150 tokens, including repeated səmle97/91 and repeated ksaymitu112/213, each with its own occurrence index. Root-wide routine counts are background only.

Readiness kār recurs with brides, escorts, trousseau and war preparation; these continue the earlier extraction from mismatched I.15/I.14. The takkuz outfitting at97/8 belongs provisionally to care/provision2 rather than being silently treated as the kār noun.

Departure ḥaraka is repeatedly instantiated by ships and people, sometimes with overt l-agent and sometimes agent plus l-vehicle. Broader action/movement113/143 belongs to the earlier ḥarake item. The bare ʕal pressure construction102/20 has no overt noun and merits20, with one attestation and possible ellipsis flagged.

Longing beriye, liking ḥaz and self-regard ḥas me ruḥo keep experiencer as subject and their target within the nominal/prepositional frame. German passive popularity does not change the Turoyo argument coding.

Ḥəzbe calculation of arrival time alternates with ḥəzər; social regard uses the same/similar account noun with l-person or affected personal suffix. Do not group timing and esteem solely by the edition's English/German gloss.

99/110 and107/11 add no military sense; similarly cross-making, good works, wedding celebration, treachery, shade and exile are already indexed. New office, attack, spying and sound nouns go to Idiomatic phrases.

Samwa108/3 is provisionally Infectum-wa by the reduced sam- stem and missing l-agent suffix; səmli98/78 is provisionally1sg Preterit by short vowel and German perfect. Both retain the original spelling and explicit questions.

Alignment-flagged100/29,107/10,110/7,111/92,111/97 and112/355 are excluded from new quotations. In particular, the supplied German at111/97 is from another part of the scene, despite the reader's claim about rühr sie nicht wieder auf.

Plain concrete manufacture of a cigarette112/268 remains1. The proposed specialized cover meaning of ḥəkəm112/289 is withheld because the noun and haw do not yet establish it independently of German shade paraphrase.

Final job reviews62 supplied occurrences, including repeated hospitality, miracle and effort forms. Together the11 jobs cover1,562 explicit occurrences; routine_counts remain root-wide evidence and are not multiplied.

Detransitive contexts distinguish manufactured soap1, prepared communal food2 and crafted books in Preterit-wa1. The latter is a new cell, not an absent box: cumulative Preterit-wa4 already exists from2/10. Detransitive finite wording and nominal Infinitiv filing must remain distinct.

Correct translation: 'ein Schlange' → 'eine Schlange'
rationale: Schlange is feminine; the accusative comparison requires “eine Schlange”. This grammatical typo also occurs in the supplied edition translation.

summary: Correct translation: 'Gottsverehrung' → 'Gottesverehrung'
rationale: The compound is Gottesverehrung; the supplied 11/164 translation also has “Gottesverehrung”. The e is missing from the glossary.

summary: Correct 'au schwören' → 'zu schwören'
rationale: The infinitive complement of “sich anschicken” is “zu schwören”; au is a typo.

summary: Correct 'lj 175' → 'JL 175'
rationale: The Lehrbuch siglum is JL, used in all three detailed citations in the same idiom. lj reverses the initials.

summary: Correct 'er setzte der Major sein weg' → 'der Major setzte seinen Weg'
before: er setzte der Major sein weg
rationale: The current text duplicates the subject (“er ... der Major”), uses nominative sein for the accusative object, and leaves the noun Weg lowercase. The correction retains the stated meaning and the rest of the translation.

summary: Correct 'anwender' → 'anwenden'
rationale: “wollte ... eine List ... anwenden” requires the infinitive anwenden; anwender is an obvious final-letter typo, also present in the supplied corpus translation.

summary: Correct 'den Knechten zu verwalten' → 'die Knechte zu verwalten'
rationale: verwalten takes an accusative object; den Knechten is a dative plural, incompatible with the verb. The Turoyo a=greʕe denotes the servants being managed, and the cited edition describes dealing with the servants.

summary: Correct 'sorge machen' → 'Sorge machen'
rationale: Sorge is a German noun and is capitalized correctly in the following translation in this same idiom.

summary: Correct 'für j-m' → 'für j-n'
rationale: für governs the accusative, so the abbreviation must be j-n (jemanden), not the dative j-m (jemandem).

summary: Correct 'Verwandtschart' → 'Verwandtschaft'
rationale: The noun is Verwandtschaft. The cited 27/22 edition translation has the correct form; r is a transcription error for f.

summary: Result-role predication includes appointing or assigning partners, a cloth bearing blood spots, adoption and slave status; material identity change is not required.
Deictic hawxa with hand specification can describe a gesture; the verb retains broad doing and the manner is supplied by context.
With xu/xaq plus animal, sym can describe imitating an animal, here its call in parallel with bark and crow. Manner supplies the performance; no new lexical sound sense.
A name predication can designate adopted identity; making interests one expresses common cause. Both preserve productive result predication.
m- can specify an anatomical site beside the ʕam-partner. It adds an argument specification rather than a new sexual event meaning.
The b-complement can be explicit words or a judgement, not only pronominal diḏ-.

Result predication also covers gradual raising as a fattening animal, social classification of a dog as a person, and giving eggs colours. Duration or nonliteral classification does not require a new number.
namūs honorable conduct is not restricted to fighting: returning the bride and respecting others supplies a non-combat context.
87/3 may supply another d-clause causative, but unresolved mbišġolo prevents treating it as independent clear support.
b- can introduce a resource in questions what to do with something, as well as an affected person in b-qarʕ-person. These contextual roles do not independently establish new verb meanings.
qəzd d- targeting extends figuratively from a destination to God and a helper as refuge or appeal.
Actual magical transformation into doves is distinguished from feigning/disguise I.6 by subsequent flight. A lion costume in61/323 supplies an explicit dalq and is retained as disguise.
ḥarake/ḥaraka includes setting out and sustained activity, alongside earlier taking steps; departure is contextually bounded, not a new verb meaning.
b-šira advice continues the compliance frame, distinct from giving advice with a bare noun.
With b-ʕayne and recipient, sym can describe a signal with the eyes; whether a sign noun is omitted remains open.
Making a wish ʕiš, making someone a support ḥaṣo, and making someone awake šyar retain result predication across abstract, figurative and state predicates.
ṭəlba d- extends from heading toward a place to directing an appeal to God and a person, parallel to qəzd.
Direct material objects can denote craft work, e.g. gold as what is worked, not production of the element itself.
Bare xabro object can denote carrying out the father’s word, beside explicit b-xabro compliance.

Role/state result predicates include trustee waṣi, evaluation as noble ǧwameriye, becoming public haškara, and ruined baṭmiš. These extend productive result predication rather than requiring a number per predicate.
The b-qarʕ- affected frame also targets a meadow, not just people; ʕiš and mede supply a general act, without a lexical infliction sense.
naṣib with God as subject extends marriage allotment to food/providence; ḥaz extends human liking to divine pleasure without an overt target.
Sexual partner can be b-marked (appe, ebi), alongside inherited ʕam; the virginity context establishes sexual content rather than a generic affected-person b-frame.

Result predicates extend to judicial barat acquitted, evaluative sahliye easy and raḥatsəz uncomfortable, musical sazkar tuned, personified throne hesir captive, and an old affair made new. Evaluation can resume a theme with -yo and mark the person judged with -li.
ḥəzbo/ḥəzbe/ḥəzba calculation, expectation and reckoning must be distinguished from ḥəsbe/ḥəzbe social regard. Possession, d-clause and personal target coding help disambiguate.

Body-part iḏoṯe hands stands metonymically for human agents. Gawruṯo manliness/heroic action can be ironic or evaluated by a speaker, as in a father's blow to his wife. Animal farxe production leaves laying, hatching or rearing unspecified.
Sound production extends to quoted cries ay/uy and the appeal amman daxil. These align with existing kazkaz and ʕəmʕəm; no numbered speech-production sense follows.
ǧahd/ǧəhad effort is the existing ǧəhād noun family; waḏ̣ifa, sobahiye, ṭowuṯo, naməs, ṣluṯo, shade and qəs d- likewise continue indexed families rather than new numbered meanings.
Jan's simo falge d xərbe supports the result-state construction already proposed as round-1 Detransitive4; box remains uncertain, so no duplicate proposal or example.
Putting dough into the oven supports round-1 placement I.16; soap leaving grease is less secure and stays broad I.1.
Registered property, monetary denomination, educated people and institutional conversion extend productive result predication without new technical senses.

Round-1 tapo, ǧasusiye, šar, ʕəṣyan, ḏ̣əlm, məštuṯo, ṣluṯo, idara, ḥanak, dəṯṯe ḥḏo and terǧămaniye receive Jan support, including spelling variants and new target coding; none is proposed a second time.
Lime and charcoal are manufactured products, while orchard creation and rules extend the object range. Process details belong to context, not a new technical verb meaning.
The government causes a distinct cars-subject d-event, confirming round1 caused-event sense19.
Promotion of Midyat to walaye extends the round1 Detransitive result construction to administrative status.
Livestock darmala, person sərgun and a booked straw quantity retain productive patient/result syntax. Their domain does not justify new numbers.

Round1 ʕaskariye, šahro, səḥər, ḥazəryo, mxabara, idara, tapo, tarǧumaniye, mʕayana, taʕadda, năḥaqqiye and kaysuṯo receive additional Jan attestations or spelling/government variants. Batch1 mətahədiye contracting continues with a straw supply contract.
Batch1 tafriqa separation is used for drawing socially consequential distinctions, without a second headword.
Negative divine causation continues the independently controlled event complement; no separate permission/ordaining number.
misəm ṭayo extends round1 result predication to religious status. səmwo šamošo is semantically related but morphologically unresolved and withheld.
Part act. sayome combines with an event šuġlo and product ʕəraq; the cell is already well represented after round1, so Jan adds a participant-range note rather than redundant quotations.

Round1 muḥaraba/mḥaraba, ləʕboyat/ləʕboye, geraʕ/gera, qačaġ/qačaxčitiye, ṣlibo, taʕaddiye, ǧahale and xəš xəš/xušxuš remain the same nominal families. Detransitive qačaġ/qačaġčiye supplies event-performance D1 evidence.
Agricultural care includes a half-produce arrangement and b more role coding; animal stock keeping must not be called sacrifice without ritual evidence.
Siyase extends from political participation to calculated interpersonal conduct; rabuṯo with ʕal-domain is lordship, contrasted with rabuṯo paid to a recipient in batch1.
Care/cultivation extends to wheat crops, without a new grow sense.
Round1 placement extends to putting wood, scheduling an observance on a named day and placing territory in someone's hands.
Literary products include theological books, sermons and mimro; syomayḏi is a result noun. Production of a Syriac roman does not by itself establish original authorship rather than translation.
Reflexive substitution badalan l-person and office/title result predicates continue making into; financial result4250 remains unresolved.

idara means providing livelihood in financial/family contexts, within the round1 index; marasəm, ṣluṯo, kuhnuṯo, qačaġ, qandelo, taʕadda and ʕeḏo families remain existing nominal constructions. Precaution ḥtiyat is distinct from reserve military service.
Reflexive ruḥo plus b-domain expresses application to recitation/expression in this context, without establishing general language study.

Round1 placement covers wedding crown on head, arranging languages separately in a book and incorporating words into spoken language. Crown tokens add object clitic plus b-locative, with masculine/feminine head possessors.

Round1 result predication includes appointment as xori, muxtar and patriarch, with ʕal iḏe d-agent/mediator or bu amro authority. Waqəf books are a possible further status result, but Simiwa morphology is unresolved.
School establishment extends physical building to the institutional participant. The evidence does not separate founding the organization from constructing its premises.
Detransitive school establishment and constructed roads continue the existing building sense; Detransitive numbering is not parallel to active I.3.
General making extends to enacted law, documentary book, programme and letters; round1 already fills Preterit D1, so no redundant Jan examples. Protesto is a deontic event-performance context.

Existing interview qəbol gains qəbolo and mqablonuṯo variants; ǧġaliye additionally denotes a public speech directed mqabəl an audience/target, beyond the valid batch4 conversation use. Speech mimre may contrast with composed poems but awaits source clarification.
rišuṯo continues round1 rišoyuṯo leadership and batch4 aġatiye. Hired-work gəraʕ continues batch3 greʕuṯo; it should not simply be equated with round1 gera foot-threshing.

Existing commerce taǧara is metaphorical in polemical political business. Wariḏe in a settlement context evokes vessels/veins as a figure for embedding oneself; its exact wording is retained as a question rather than a new roots noun.

Existing ḥəčča, propoġanda, ʕaskariye, šahro, wedding, kef, beriye, ǧasara, waḏ̣ifa and sadaqa families recur without new numbered senses. ǧasara with personal ʕal expresses presumptuous conduct; advertising spans a font/programme and household products.
Care extends to setting/treating an injured arm without implying surgical operation I.13; current Preterit cell is already full.
b diḏi and contracted b dəṯṯe repeat compliance government. The Infectum cell is already full after round1, despite the reader's original low count.
Commissioned tailoring makes the actual producer distinct from the causer; service causation has overt ebi causee, although masəmwalle aspect/person remain unresolved.
